batting.name: ML Hayden
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b WPUJC Vaas

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b WPUJC Vaas

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b PP Ojha

batting.name: JM Kemp
batting.dismissal: st AC Gilchrist b PP Ojha

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c RP Singh b RG Sharma

batting.name: L Balaji
batting.dismissal: c Anirudh Singh b RP Singh

balls.text: driven hard down the ground to long-off for a single
beamer, slipped out, went over the batsman, a no-ball for height,  second of the over and he's been taken off the attack, what a torrid day for the youngster
length ball again and Rohit sends this one sailing into the stands over long-on, one of the biggest sixes in the tournament so far, Deccan are piling it on
Tyagi's figures worsen, as does his bowling, short, gift ball outside off, Rohit makes room and cuts him smartly over point to beat third man and deep point
momentary relief, just the single, short outside off, guided to third man
four more, bowls it on a good length outside off, Suman gets forward and clatters that through the gap between long-off and deep cover
Tyagi, having a horrible day, follows that up with a wide down the leg side, it's actually given a no-ball for height, slipped out
there's no respite for the poor bowler as Suman creams him past a diving extra cover to the ropes, blazing drive
short outside off, cut away straight to point, Suman is struggling at the striker;'s end but the fielder misses his mark and concedes an overthrow
moved well across to flick that one fine but it ends up being a low full toss, plays it back to the bowler
Rohit had picked his spot, it was pitched up outside off and he bisected the gap between long-off and deep cover with an elegant loft
full toss on middle, pushed wide of midwicket for a single
short of a length outside off, guided down to third man for a single

appeal for a run-out, it's played just in front of Hayden at extra cover, he picks it up and hurls an accurate throw at the non-striker's end after Symonds, halfway through the pitch, is sent back, replays indicate he is just inches short of the crease, timely wicket for Chennai, just when a late surge had been initiated
Rohit eases that into the deep on the off side for a single
reaches his half-century, which began on an uncertain note but then shaped up nicely, with a swat to long-off for a single
bowls it on a length outside off, in the slot and Symonds was prepared, making room and bludgeoning it over long-off into the stands for a big one
stretches and cracks it wide of deep cover for a couple of runs

run-out, excellent fielding by Morkel off his own bowling, yorker length outside off, digs it out back to the bowler who collects with his outstretched left hand, turns around and aims accurately at the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Gibbs well short. Some problem with the light again, though the umpires in the middle have been given the word that Gibbs is gone.
bowls it on a good length outside off, gets outside the line and flicks it towards deep square leg for a single
poor ball to end the over, full toss outside off and it's swatted hard through extra cover for a boundary to beat long-off
full on middle, drills it towards wide long-on for a single
full and wide, Gibbs left it alone thinking it'll be given a wide but it wasn't, fair call
held back his length just a hint, Gibbs bent low and slog-swept it between long-on and deep midwicket to the boundary
fires it full again, driven down towards long-on for a single
lovely bowling, quicker through the air and in the blockhole on middle, Symonds digs it out back to the bowler
short and wide, makes room and cuts it hard to deep point for a single
straying down the leg side this time, tries to work it fine, concedes another run does Balaji
slower one bowled short on middle, he picked it and dispatched it high and handsome into the stands over deep midwicket for a massive six
short of a length on leg stump, comes down the track and tries to pull it past square leg, is struck on the pads and steals a leg-bye
short of a length on middle, chops it in front of point for a single
in the blockhole on middle, digs it out behind point for a single to third man
short of a length on the off, makes room and mistimes a pull towards long-on
jabs it off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single to keep the strike
kept really low, short outside off, he shaped himself for the cut but was nowhere near it as it shot down but Dhoni did well to collect
comes down the track and chips it down on the bounce to long-on
Murali, what's happening? Flights it this time but gets the direction wrong, another one past leg stump a Gibbs goes for the sweep
Murali falters again, another wide down the leg side
fires it down the leg side, Gibbs lets it go, earns an extra ball
short and Gibbs launches that into the stands, moves away and pulls it powerfully over midwicket
works it away behind square, Gibbs calls, Symonds is late to respond but eventually obliges, had the throw from square leg been accurate he was a gonner
sweeps it straight to short fine
bowls it full outside off, digs it out in front of the bowler and steals a quick run
bowls it full outside off, makes room and then has to reach for it, pushes it past extra cover for a single
bowls it on a length outside off, tries to crash it through the off side, gets a thick inside edge into the leg side
full toss on middle, flicked towards deep square leg for a couple of runs
delicate touches, moves across, it's bowled full on middle, just turns the face to glance it really fine to the boundary
yorker to begin with, makes room and Morkel follows him, targeting the blockhole, Symonds fails to dig it out and it just misses leg stump
misses a full toss does Gibbs, gets a thick edge and Dhoni can't get his body behind it, they steal a couple more to raise the 50-stand
bowls it short on the off, slaps it wide of extra cover for one more
flighted on middle, driven through the line towards long-on for a single
keeping it flat, on middle and leg, flicked away behind square for a single
Gibbs drags that towards deep square leg for a single
sees him come down and fires it full on middle, works it into the leg side for a single
short and wide, chops it down towards third man for a single

the poor ball gets pasted once again, Balaji errs in length again, dropping it short outside off, Symonds makes room and cuts it powerfully over point, one bounce four, deserved a six there for sheer power, would have been the flattest ever
that's blasted over long-off, got the right ball, bowled it on a length on the off, makes room and thrashes it with utter contempt, nice way to end that run-drought
bowls it on a good length outside off, chops it straight to point, the crowd cheers, Symonds, will he give way?
beaten this time, Balaji bowls that at 136.3 kmph, makes room and tries to dab it with an open face, misses, the pressure builds
Symonds is getting frustrated here, short of a length outside off, makes room and tries to slap Balaji past extra cover, can't connect
smart cricket, short of a length outside off, makes room and cuts it past point for a couple into the deep
went straight on, short of a length outside off, Gibbs tried to open the face but was beaten
flighted on middle, driven hard down the ground to long-on for a single
lofts it inside out over cover, it land just short of the fielder in the deep, just the single
Gibbs bends low and plays the reverse-paddle and gets it past short third man with the back of the bat, that was out in gully cricket but he's picked the gap to find the boundary, delicately done
slower one this time, on middle and leg, pushed towards mid-on

punished, short on the off and it's smacked hard off the front foot through midwicket for another boundary, just some more pace on the ball after the spinners were given a break, and he's taken advantage
slower one bowled outside off, drags it straight to midwicket
gets hold of this one, bowls it on a good length on middle, Gibbs moves away and just lofts him with ease over mid-off for a boundary
moves away and plays that straight to extra cover, trying to improvise here is Gibbs
bowls it just a fraction outside off, Gibbs gets forward and slices it over point, just about, for a couple of runs
Gibbs goes for a heave across the line, gets a single to midwicket
this time Gibbs gets a couple by placing the ball wide of Murali
make that four scoreless deliveries, Gibbs guides it straight to Murali at short third
another dot ball, regulation offspinner, Gibbs turns it towards square leg
the doosra this time, again Gibbs doesn't make contact
full and wide outside off, Gibbs bends his knee and looks to sweep, misses
that one gets through him, it was back of a length just outside off, he looked to dab it towards backward point but misses, Dhoni doesn't collect cleanly, batsmen think of a single but don't take it
again angling into leg, Gibbs tucks the ball towards square leg
on middle and leg this time, nudges behind square leg by Symonds
on offstump, Symonds stretches forward and pushes the ball towards mid-on
similar delivery, closer to offstump, no room to free the arms, Symonds can only squeeze it towards gully
short of length and just outside off, Symonds dabs it towards backward point
Kemp fires his first ball in IPL down the leg side
short of a good length on the off, turns his wrists and pats it down towards midwicket
short and wide, cuts it hard down to third man to open his account, off his eighth ball, in a Twenty20 game
banged it short on middle, ducks under it well, a bit more pace on that one
angling in towards the off stump, eased off the front foot towards deep cover for a single
Gibbs gets a boundary, was pitched short on the off and he thumped it hard past the diving mid-on to the ropes
Gibbs gets forward and plays an elegant drive to extra cover, was pitched up but he couldn't beat the in-field
short of a length on the off, punched off the back foot to mid-on
beaten there, bowls the top-spinner, takes off the pitch and goes on straight to just escape his attempted defence
short down the leg side and turns down further, a wide
drops it into the leg side behind the keeper, calls for a single but it's not there
turns it in , Symonds is again struck on the pad but it would have clearly gone down
shortish on the, gets across and turns it behind square for a single
varying his pace here, slow through the air and plenty of flight, turns in to rap Symonds on the pads as he tries to work it into the leg side, would have been sliding down

Do we have a run out?  Gibbs nudges it into the leg side in front of square leg, Raina charges forward and flicks an accurate throw to the keeper, there is hesitation out in the middle and Laxman is late to react to the single and is found short as Dhoni collects and whips out the bails

bowled'im, Gilchrist has been sent back, slower through the air and gave it some flight, Gilchrist stepped out of his crease to crack it through the leg side, it landed on leg to spin away and beat the swing of the bat to crash into middle and off
Not the best start here, down the leg side again, another wide
targeting middle this time and Gilchrist, despite the cover in the deep on the leg side, backs himself to go after him, bends low and sweeps it hard behind square for a boundary
fires it down the leg side, much quicker but the direction wrong, the 50's up
kept it flat and got it to turn in, Laxman had shaped up for a drive through the off but turned the face at the right time to nudge it into the leg side for a single
short of a length on leg stump, punched towards the widish long-on for a single
uncharacteristic of Laxman as he tries to slog that over midwicket by charging forward, misses and is struck high on the pads
counter-attacks, steps out to that flight delivery, takes it on a length and drives it hard past Murali and mid-off to the boundary
the doosra, Laxman made room, it zipped away after pitching, tried to open the face did Laxman, got a thick edge which Dhoni put down, sharp chance, two missed today off Lax
short of a length on middle, pull sit straight to short fine
pitches outside leg and turns in, gets forward and clips it towards square leg for a single
shortish on the off, turning in, works it away behind midwicket for a single to give his dominant partner the strike
another productive over comes to an end, both bowlers haven't been spared, low full toss on the off, driven straight to extra cover

Gilchrist's gone berserk, not quite pitched up but lands on a length on the off stump, Gilchrist has a swing, connects well and clears the midwicket boundary with ease, lands in the empty space on the front tier of a stand under construction
Morkel falters by pitching this one short, on the off stump and Gilchrist gets into position early to pull it over midwicket for another boundary

wham, Morkel's been struck, pitched it up on the off and Gilchrist blazed it back past the bowler, ferocious power and Morkel, who stuck his hand out, has been dealt a painful blow as it grazed his finger, nothing serious I hope though he is getting some treatment from the physio
holds back his length a little there, punches it from the crease towards extra cover
full on the off, tries to crash it through the off side, bowled at 126 kmph, ends up playing it towards mid-on
angling it on the pads, struck high on the thigh as he tries to whip it away, squeezes a leg bye
terrible delivery to follow up those two murderous hits, short down the leg side and Gilchrist helps it down to the fine-leg boundary

...to get thumped! Full on the off stump, again in the right slot for the left-hander, gets under it and with one clean strike, clears long-off comfortably, big cheers from this supportive crowd, they're out there to watch an entertaining contest and they're getting it
One of many, the Deccan fans will hope, Gilchrist warms up thanks to a juicy length ball outside off stump, there is enough room for him to dismiss that over the extra cover boundary for a flat six

came onto him quickly there, bowled it at 134 kmph, quick for his pace, Laxman was a little late to react to that fullish delivery on middle, tried to drive it through midwicket, got an inside edge onto his pads and managed a single
targeting the blockhole there, dug out wide of extra cover for a single
short of a good length outside off, chops it down in front of point

edged, and between keeper and slip, the slip was a touch too wide there, it's pitched up and Laxman attempts an expansive drive, there is movement in the air, he gets a thick outside edge and neither slip nor the keeper go for it, a chance missed
bowls it on a good length on the off stump, gets it to dart in, Laxman, rooted to his crease, plays the 129 kmph delivery back to the bowler
angling in from round the wicket and Gilchrist attempts a similar shot, gets across a hint and tries to clip it fine, is struck high on the thighs and earns a single behind square
sliding down the leg side, Gilchrist tries to flick that fine but is unable to connect, a wide nevertheless
short of a good length outside off, guided towards third man for a single
comes around the wicket, hurls it short on the off, Gilchrist jabs it off the back foot towards square leg for a single
full on the pads, whipped away towards deep square leg for a single, Deccan ease to victory
RP follows that one with an excellent yorker, digs it out into the off side
Too late but the fans won't mind, pitched up and, not for the first time, he goes straight, smashing that one over long-on
slower one outside off, reaches for it, misses, given a wide
crashed hard, full on the off, makes room and thwacks that past long-off who didn't have to move much but such was the power involved in that one that he had no chance
pushed towards long-off for a single, wants the second but Morkel sends him back
bowled it on a good length outside off, swung hard but was nowhere near it
gets a single to deep midwicket, just heaved it but mistimed
slower one bowled short outside off, slapped towards wide long-on, just the single
belated release, full on middle, he gets under it and dismisses it into the stands over long-on
slower one bowled short outside off, drops it dead in front of cover
Tyagi gets a single, getting a thick outside edge to short third
Symonds strikes again, Murali, normally a batsman with plenty of spunk, has one of his off days, swinging across the line to a straight one on middle, is struck on the pads and we know the result
eased towards extra cover for a single
the entertainment ends, bowls it full on the off, makes room and tries to clear extra cover but can't, mistimes it straight to Anirudh
Balaji's deft touches, bends low to that attempted yorker and paddles it past short fine for a boundary
full on leg stump, flicked away just wide of deep midwicket but the fielders have been sharp today, restrict them to just the single
short on middle, too short, ducks under it, too high and it's a wide
struck hard towards long-off for a single, the end is near, or 16 balls away, or three wickets, this game is a done thing
short of a length outside off, tries to cut it hard past point, chops it towards the keeper
full toss on middle, pushed away towards long-on for one more
I told you so, Balaji picks up that length ball and clanks it over deep midwicket for a massive six
dragged it towards deep square leg for a single
Balaji, who's quite capable, tries to swing that into the stands, manages an inside edge onto the pads and gets a single
full toss again which Morkel fails to dispatch, just a single to deep midwicket
short, punched towards long-off for a single
full toss but mistimed, tried to heave it over deep midwicket but just managed a couple
driven down the ground to long-on for a single
short outside off, goes for the cut, misses

Ashwin goes first ball, he struck that well but RP, who's had a great day with catches, snaps another testing one, lofted inside out and he ran a few yards from long-off to stretch at just the right time and clasp it with both hands
full outside off, reaches for it and digs it towards cover for a single
Albie starts his attack, flighted on leg stump, steps out and makes room and lofts it clean over long-on
Symonds gets the decisive blow, appeared to hurry on to Dhoni, short of a good length on middle, Dhoni, playing from the crease, tried to whip that through midwicket, missed and was bowled
short of a good length, tries to swat it past Symonds, mistimes it back to the bowler
Dhoni gets one in the meat, pitched up on the off stump and he picks it up to send that packing over long-on for a flat six
full on leg stump, driven uppishly towards deep midwicket for a single
short and wide, cut away towards deep point for a single
short of a good length on the off, pushed wide of cover for a single
turning in from outside leg stump, tries to work it square, it drops dead into the leg side, time for the second time-out and a much-needed break for my fingers
full toss on middle, comes down, whips it down to short fine, Vaas fumbles
short of a length on middle, punched off the back foot through midwicket for a single, Dhoni wants the second and there was one available but Albie doesn't
One of many more, the crowd will hope, lands on a length on the off and he strikes it cleanly through the line over long-off
bowls it full and almost in the blockhole, dug out towards long-on, just the single
flighted outside off, slaps it awkwardly to long-on for one more
fullish on the off, drags it down towards long-on for a couple more
slower one, bowled short on middle, pushed it towards midwicket to steal a quick one
bowls it full on middle, driven down the ground to long-on for a single
clipped off his pads towards short fine where Jaskaran fumbles
bowls it full on middle,, drives it down towards long-on
bowls it on a good length outside off, tries to dispatch him over long-on but Vaas isn't so easy to dispatch, lands on the bounce in front of the fielder in the deep, single
turning in from outside leg stump, drops it in front of midwicket
full toss on middle, smacked towards deep square leg for a single
drilled down the ground towards long-off for a single
short on leg stump, worked off his hips to square leg
gave him some width there, slapped hard down the ground to long-off
turns in sharply from outside leg stump, tries to work it around, gets a leading edge wide of extra cover, they sneak a single
Dhoni gears up, pitched up and he meets it with a ruthless shovel over the bowler's head to crash into the long-on boundary
gets forward and drives him past a diving extra cover for a single
swats it hard towards long-off for a single
Flighted on the off, leans forward and drives it towards long-off
short on middle, pulled away to deep midwicket for a single
shortish on the off, slapped on the bounce to extra cover

Ojha has his revenge, beautifully bowled, deceived the batsman in flight and altered his length to hold it back, it landed on the off stump as Kemp charged forward and tried to play it into the off side, and turned away to beat his reach while Gilchrist did the rest. Chennai are sinking, but Dhoni's still there
short of a length on middle, worked away through square leg into the deep for a couple as deep square leg takes time to get to it
flighted and Kemp takes full toll, dances down the track and launches him over long-off for a big six
short on middle, gets back and punches it past midwicket for a single
flighted outside leg stump, swept straight towards fine leg for a single
short of a good length on the off, eased towards cover for a single
full on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single
pushed off the back foot straight to extra cover
steps out of his crease and tries to work it into the leg side, is struck on the pads
short of a length on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single
pushed off the front foot wide of extra cover for a single
short on the off, pulled away wide of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
good, tight bowling here, gets forward and taps it back down the pitch, Chennai have a long long way to go
gets forward and plays him watchfully into the leg side
flighted on middle, driven through the line to long-on for a single
opts to play it from the crease this time, taps it past point for a single
beaten by the turn, spun away sharply after Kemp came forward to defend
drew him forward there with the flighted one and even produced the outside edge but it sped past slip for a couple of runs
short of a good length outside off, holds its line and Dhoni leaves it be
drops it short this time, 110.7 kmph on middle, rocks back to pull it comfortably through square leg for a boundary
short and Dhoni goes for it, tries to cut it hard through point, gets a thick outside edge to evade the slip fielder and beat third man to the ropes
bouncer, banged in short on middle, too high and is called a wide
bowls it straight on middle, worked away through the huge vacant space in the leg side behind midwicket for three more
short of a length outside leg stump, easy pickings for Kemp who helps it along to the fine-leg boundary
starts well, a tight line just outside off, defended solidly into the off side
pushed gently in front of mid-on to steal a quick single
targeting middle and leg, gets across and turns it towards midwicket
shortish on middle, tucked into the leg side for a single

Badrinath has holed out, tossed up outside off and he saw the invitation, moved away and tried to loft him wide of long-off but couldn't, found the fielder who just had to take a few steps to his left. The pressure was building with all those dot balls, and Chennai's chase has been dealt another setback
short of a length, moves back and cuts it to point
short on middle, worked away wide of square leg for a single
short of a good length on the off, drops it towards point
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, punched straight to extra cover again, dot ball
driven crisply on the up but finds extra cover, a testing over, Kemp's watching at the other end
bowls it on a good length on the off, defends it into the leg side from the crease, was a little surprised by the extra bounce there
beats the outside edge, gets it to leave the right hander as Badrinath tries to prod at it off the front foot, misses

gone! Hayden's dismissal is quite similar to Misbah's in the World Twenty20 final in 2007, Vaas bowled it fullish on the off, Hayden bent low, went across and tried to scoop it over short fine but found more elevation than he would have desired, RP, waiting patiently, moved a few steps to his right and held on to a well-judged catch. What a blow!
he'd rather be bowling to him, plays it straight back to the bowler
short of a good length on the off, defended towards extra cover
drilled down the ground towards mid-on for one more
A flat six, bowls it just outside off and he strikes it firmly through the line, didn't think it would go all the way but there was plenty of power involved, clears long-off comfortably
opens the face and guides it down to third man for a single
Hayden gets into position early, short outside off and he pulls that to wide long-on for a single
nice touches, shortish on middle and leg, turns the face and guides it really fine, beating fine leg to the boundary
lands on a good length on the off, gets forward and defends it towards cover

Vaas bites back! Another audacious attempt but Raina falters this time, it's short and wide, he makes room to cut it hard through point, gets a thick outside edge and Gilchrist reacts well, moving quickly to his left to snap a sharp one
takes no time in setting himself up, not a bad ball at all but he had made his mind up, swinging it hard over midwicket and into the stands
bowls it on a good length on the off, defended back to the bowler

bowled'im! Some movement inward but that was always heading just one way, M Vijay gave him the charge and tried to smash him over midwicket, swung hard, got an inside edge and the leg stump was knocked off
driven hard but straight to mid-off
Hayden tees off, a bit of air on that one and it landed on a length on the off stump, made a bit of room and thumped that miles over long-off
bowls it full on leg stump, driven through midwicket into the deep for a couple, took a while for long-on to get to it
three dot balls, short of a length outside off, slaps it back to Rohit who dives to his right to save the single
bowled it full on the off, cracks it back to the bowler
short of a length on the off, slapped to extra cover
bowls it on a good length on the off, moves across to crack it over midwicket, is struck on the pads but outside the line
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, was through the shot a little early there, got a thick outside edge before landing short of point
a touch too straight, flicked away from the crease through square leg for a couple of runs
full on middle, driven down towards mid-on to get off the mark
bowled at 114.5 kmph on middle, defended into the leg side towards Rohit who flicks a needless throw to concede an extra run
bowls it on a good length on the off, steps forward and defends it back to the bowler
